issues.summary: The proof promotes fixed-index convergence to a maximum over a growing range without valid uniform tail control. The lemma is refuted by the recorded Bernoulli array; an independently found deterministic moving-coordinate array also directly refutes the exact estimator theorem.

strategies.name: union_bound
strategies.attempt: Bound P(max_{j<=m_n} |X_{n,j}| > eps) by m_n * sup_j P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) using only the stated per-fixed-j hypothesis.
strategies.evidence: The hypothesis fixes no rate: sup_j P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) may decay arbitrarily slowly, so m_n times it need not vanish; the Bernoulli(1/n) array with m_n = n^2 realizes exactly this failure.

strategies.name: subsequence_argument
strategies.attempt: Extract along subsequences of n to recover the maximum's convergence from per-fixed-j convergence.
strategies.evidence: Along every subsequence the same growing union appears; the counterexample tail 1 - (1 - 1/n)^{n^2} tends to one along every subsequence.

strategies.name: strengthened_hypothesis_variant
strategies.attempt: Add a uniform tail bound sup_j P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) <= a_n(eps) with m_n * a_n(eps) -> 0 for every eps > 0, then close the growing union with the union bound.
strategies.evidence: Under the added uniform rate, P(max > eps) <= m_n * a_n(eps) -> 0 closes S004/M001 locally for every eps; the full affected-closure recheck remains required.

suggested_changes.proposal: Add the hypothesis sup_{1<=j<=m_n} P(|X_{n,j}| > eps) <= a_n(eps) with m_n a_n(eps) -> 0 for every eps > 0, and derive line 16 from the union bound under it.
Replace the growing range 1..m_n by a fixed finite range 1..K in the lemma and in every downstream use, so the finite union bound closes the step.

resolution_evidence_needed: A revised statement or hypothesis set under which the growing-maximum step is provable.
Full rechecks of lem:growing-max, thm:main, the D001 dependency use, and both required challenges.
